digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: rebar lacks an aggregation layer and durable metrics to track agent-loop trends, code-health decay, and gate effectiveness over time

three tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace in the event store: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused this bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)

blame-derived caused_by auto-derivation targets the pre-fix commit (parent of the fixing commit) over the bug's file_impact; explicit --caused-by override always wins, and auto-derived edges are labeled confidence=classified and never treated as authoritative

the required free-text bug-close --reason argument is replaced (not supplemented) by a bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event, keeping bug-close friction flat at exactly one required bug-specific argument

rebar metrics --since <date> --until <date> --output json must emit all registered metrics with either a value or an unavailable structured error, with source and confidence labels; backfilled values carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified and are segregated from authoritative structural series
